title: Make node --test the canonical test command on Windows
description: Document node --test as the canonical, cross-platform way to run the suite and explain that npm test can fail on Windows because PowerShell execution policy blocks npm.ps1. Update the HOWTO.md prerequisites/test guidance and mirror it in AGENTS.md if it references npm test. Optionally add a warn-level win32 hint to doctor. Docs-focused; no behavior change to the test runner.
acceptance_criteria: HOWTO.md documents node --test as the canonical command and notes the PowerShell npm.ps1 execution-policy caveat.
Any npm test reference in AGENTS.md is reconciled with the node --test guidance.
